title: Private agent session-store mismatch caused control plane throttle during rolling upgrade — follow-up & action items
creator: Aisha Nadar
root_cause_summary: During a staged rolling upgrade of private agents, an incompatible change to the agent session token encoding (v2 -> v3) was deployed to a subset of hosts before the control plane feature flag was enabled. Agents emitted session tokens that the control plane rejected, which caused high reconnect churn. Reconnect storms saturated control-plane worker threads and its internal connection pool, triggering aggressive backpressure and request throttling for control-plane APIs servicing Private clusters.
incident_timeline: 2025-02-11 02:14 UTC - Upgrade window started for private-agent 3.2.0 across region-us-east-2 (staged rollout, 10% batches).
2025-02-11 02:28 UTC - Monitoring alert: control-plane auth failures spike (401/440) for private clusters; teams notified via PagerDuty.
2025-02-11 02:31 UTC - First mitigation: pause rolling upgrade at 30% after ops observed increased API latency and error budget burn on control plane.
2025-02-11 02:40 UTC - Engineering switched control-plane to permissive session decoding to accept v2 and v3 tokens; immediate reduction in auth failures observed.
2025-02-11 03:05 UTC - Emergency rollback of agent version on remaining hosts initiated; full rollback completed by 04:20 UTC.
2025-02-11 06:00 UTC - Incident declared resolved; postmortem triage scheduled.
2025-02-12 09:00 UTC - Root cause analysis concluded; proposed action items documented and assigned.
mitigations: Paused rolling upgrade at 30% and halted further agent deployment (ops, 02:31 UTC).
Removed strict session validation in control plane to accept both v2 and v3 encodings (temporary compatibility shim, 02:40 UTC).
Initiated rollback of private-agent 3.2.0 to 3.1.7 on upgraded hosts (completed 04:20 UTC).
Raised control-plane worker thread pool limits and connection queue sizes as short-term relief (config bump, 02:50 UTC).
action_items: ENG-89123-A1: Add automated compatibility gate for session-token encoding to the upgrade pipeline (owner: Marco Alvarez, due: 2025-02-28).
ENG-89123-A2: Implement feature-flagged session encoding with explicit negotiation handshake (owner: Priya Rao, due: 2025-03-05).
ENG-89123-A3: Add canary checklist that validates control-plane accepts both encodings under load (owner: SRE team, due: 2025-02-22).
ENG-89123-A4: Expand control-plane telemetry to expose token-decode-failure counts and earliest-seen-agent-version in dashboard (owner: Observability, due: 2025-02-21).
ENG-89123-A5: Update runbook for private upgrades to include pre-upgrade decoding test and rollback trigger points (owner: Ops, due: 2025-02-24).
ENG-89123-A6: Create post-deployment smoke test that opens long-lived connections to exercise auth and heartbeat paths (owner: QE, due: 2025-03-01).
ENG-89123-A7: Run a retro with release engineering to adjust staging rollout cadence and batch size policy (owner: Release Eng, due: 2025-02-26).
